title: 熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測
titleEn: Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring
summary: 熔鹽儲熱槽是直徑數十公尺的平底圓筒鋼槽，裝著數萬噸五百多度的硝酸鹽；它必須把熱保住、承受由冷到熱三十多公分的膨脹、並且在任何時候都不能讓鹽凝固。課程以 1990 年代驗證這項技術的太陽二號試驗電廠為背景，定量分析保溫層的熱通量、一天的溫降、槽體的熱膨脹、槽壁厚度、伴熱功率與液位盤點。
summaryEn: A molten-salt storage tank is a flat-bottomed cylindrical steel tank tens of metres across holding tens of thousands of tonnes of nitrate salt above five hundred degrees; it must keep the heat in, take over thirty centimetres of growth from cold to hot, and never let the salt freeze. Set against the Solar Two pilot plant that proved the technology in the 1990s, the course quantifies heat flux through insulation, a day's temperature drop, thermal growth of the tank, wall thickness, heat-tracing power and level inventory.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 五百多度的熔鹽大槽：保溫、熱膨脹、槽壁應力、伴熱防凝與鹽量盤點
v30FocusEn: Large tanks of salt above five hundred degrees: insulation, thermal expansion, wall stress, heat tracing and salt inventory

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field aperture and annual energy" is correct?
options: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。
陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。
儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。
optionsEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust.
On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels.
Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank.
quiz.explanation: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「鏡場面積與年發電量」如何決定「熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field aperture and annual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：太陽二號的額定出力為 10 MW，1996 至 1999 年間運轉
steps.observationEn: Project file: Solar Two was rated 10 MW and ran from 1996 to 1999
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「鏡場面積與年發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Field aperture and annual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 太陽二號的額定出力為 10 MW，1996 至 1999 年間運轉

quiz.question: 依「鏡場面積與年發電量」的模型 E = DNI·A·η_se，鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = DNI·A·η_se for "Field aperture and annual energy", which value is closest to the annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)?
options: 240 GWh
480 GWh
optionsEn: 240 GWh
480 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡場面積與年發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Field aperture and annual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etase 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etase by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 528 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 528 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 480 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etase 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 480 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etase with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2500 kWh/m²、Ah = 1200000 m²、etase = 0.16，得 480 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2500 kWh/m², Ah = 1200000 m², etase = 0.16 the result is 480 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 528 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 528 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field aperture and annual energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
常溫下夠強的鋼板，高溫下也一樣強。
以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Plate strong enough at room temperature is as strong at high temperature.
Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.
quiz.explanation: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field aperture and annual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
knowledge.textEn: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62862 太陽熱發電廠標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62862 series on solar thermal electric plants. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「鏡場面積與年發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field aperture and annual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。
optionsEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank.
quiz.explanation: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡場面積與年發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Field aperture and annual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1996：太陽二號開始運轉

quiz.question: 關於「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass" is correct?
options: 儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。
保溫層只要夠厚，品質就不重要。
聚光太陽熱電廠把白天多收集的熱存在熔鹽裡，日落後再用來產生蒸汽。
optionsEn: Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank.
If insulation is thick enough its quality does not matter.
A concentrating solar plant stores surplus daytime heat in molten salt and uses it after sunset to raise steam.
quiz.explanation: 聚光太陽熱電廠把白天多收集的熱存在熔鹽裡，日落後再用來產生蒸汽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A concentrating solar plant stores surplus daytime heat in molten salt and uses it after sunset to raise steam. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 儲熱量與熔鹽質量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal storage and molten-salt mass: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」如何決定「熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal storage and molten-salt mass” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光太陽熱電廠把白天多收集的熱存在熔鹽裡，日落後再用來產生蒸汽。儲熱容量以「滿載發電時數」表示；所需熱量等於電功率乘以時數再除以循環效率，熔鹽質量則等於熱量除以比熱與冷熱槽溫差。因此提高熱槽溫度有雙重好處：循環效率變高，同樣的鹽量也能存更多熱。塔式的溫差約 275 °C，槽式因導熱油耐溫限制只有約 100 °C，所需鹽量約為三倍。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A concentrating solar plant stores surplus daytime heat in molten salt and uses it after sunset to raise steam. Storage is expressed in hours of full-load generation: the heat needed is electrical power times hours divided by cycle efficiency, and salt mass is heat divided by specific heat and the hot-to-cold tank temperature difference. A hotter tank therefore helps twice, raising cycle efficiency and storing more heat per tonne. Towers work with about 275 °C of difference, troughs only about 100 °C because of oil limits, needing roughly three times the salt. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：太陽鹽由 60% 硝酸鈉與 40% 硝酸鉀組成
steps.observationEn: Project file: Solar salt is 60% sodium nitrate and 40% potassium nitrate
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Thermal storage and molten-salt mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 聚光太陽熱電廠把白天多收集的熱存在熔鹽裡，日落後再用來產生蒸汽。儲熱容量以「滿載發電時數」表示；所需熱量等於電功率乘以時數再除以循環效率，熔鹽質量則等於熱量除以比熱與冷熱槽溫差。因此提高熱槽溫度有雙重好處：循環效率變高，同樣的鹽量也能存更多熱。塔式的溫差約 275 °C，槽式因導熱油耐溫限制只有約 100 °C，所需鹽量約為三倍。
knowledge.textEn: A concentrating solar plant stores surplus daytime heat in molten salt and uses it after sunset to raise steam. Storage is expressed in hours of full-load generation: the heat needed is electrical power times hours divided by cycle efficiency, and salt mass is heat divided by specific heat and the hot-to-cold tank temperature difference. A hotter tank therefore helps twice, raising cycle efficiency and storing more heat per tonne. Towers work with about 275 °C of difference, troughs only about 100 °C because of oil limits, needing roughly three times the salt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」的模型 m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT)，滿載發電 t 小時所需的熔鹽質量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT) for "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass", which value is closest to the molten-salt mass for t hours of full-load generation?
quiz.explanation: m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT)；代入 Pe = 110 MW、hs = 10 h、etac = 0.4、cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K)、Thot = 565 °C、Tcold = 290 °C，得 24,000 t（滿載發電 t 小時所需的熔鹽質量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT); with Pe = 110 MW, hs = 10 h, etac = 0.4, cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K), Thot = 565 °C, Tcold = 290 °C the result is 24,000 t (molten-salt mass for t hours of full-load generation). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 儲熱量與熔鹽質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal storage and molten-salt mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Thermal storage and molten-salt mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT)；代入 Pe = 110 MW、hs = 10 h、etac = 0.4、cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K)、Thot = 565 °C、Tcold = 290 °C，得 24,000 t（滿載發電 t 小時所需的熔鹽質量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 hs 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT); with Pe = 110 MW, hs = 10 h, etac = 0.4, cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K), Thot = 565 °C, Tcold = 290 °C the result is 24,000 t (molten-salt mass for t hours of full-load generation). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise hs by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：hs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 26,400 t（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising hs by 10% changes the result to 26,400 t (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 24,000 t（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 hs 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 24,000 t (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in hs with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT)；代入 Pe = 110 MW、hs = 10 h、etac = 0.4、cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K)、Thot = 565 °C、Tcold = 290 °C，得 24,000 t（滿載發電 t 小時所需的熔鹽質量）。
knowledge.textEn: m = P_e·t / (η·c_p·ΔT); with Pe = 110 MW, hs = 10 h, etac = 0.4, cps = 1.5 kJ/(kg·K), Thot = 565 °C, Tcold = 290 °C the result is 24,000 t (molten-salt mass for t hours of full-load generation).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: hs 增加 10% 時，結果變為 26,400 t（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising hs by 10% changes the result to 26,400 t (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以冷熱槽液位、溫度剖面與熔鹽密度計算可用儲熱量，並在一次完整的充放熱循環中以流量與溫差積分核對。
熱存在槽裡，隔天就會散掉一大半。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Compute usable stored heat from tank levels, temperature profiles and salt density, and check by integrating flow and temperature difference over one complete charge-discharge cycle.
Heat stored in a tank is mostly gone by the next day.
quiz.explanation: 以冷熱槽液位、溫度剖面與熔鹽密度計算可用儲熱量，並在一次完整的充放熱循環中以流量與溫差積分核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute usable stored heat from tank levels, temperature profiles and salt density, and check by integrating flow and temperature difference over one complete charge-discharge cycle. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 儲熱量與熔鹽質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal storage and molten-salt mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal storage and molten-salt mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以冷熱槽液位、溫度剖面與熔鹽密度計算可用儲熱量，並在一次完整的充放熱循環中以流量與溫差積分核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute usable stored heat from tank levels, temperature profiles and salt density, and check by integrating flow and temperature difference over one complete charge-discharge cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：熔鹽槽的升溫、降溫速率與最低液位要訂為運轉限制，底板與基礎溫度須連續監測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Heating and cooling rates and minimum level of salt tanks should be operating limits, with floor and foundation temperature monitored continuously.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熱槽底板因熱脹冷縮受基礎摩擦約束而挫屈、銲道開裂，熔鹽滲入基礎；新月沙丘電廠即因熱槽洩漏而長期停機。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A hot-tank floor restrained by foundation friction during thermal cycling buckles and cracks at welds, leaking salt into the foundation; Crescent Dunes was shut for long periods by hot-tank leaks. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以冷熱槽液位、溫度剖面與熔鹽密度計算可用儲熱量，並在一次完整的充放熱循環中以流量與溫差積分核對。
knowledge.textEn: Compute usable stored heat from tank levels, temperature profiles and salt density, and check by integrating flow and temperature difference over one complete charge-discharge cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 熔鹽槽的升溫、降溫速率與最低液位要訂為運轉限制，底板與基礎溫度須連續監測。
knowledge.textEn: Heating and cooling rates and minimum level of salt tanks should be operating limits, with floor and foundation temperature monitored continuously.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：SolarPACES 定日鏡與反射鏡量測指引。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: SolarPACES guidelines for heliostat and reflectance measurement. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
保溫層只要夠厚，品質就不重要。
熱槽底板因熱脹冷縮受基礎摩擦約束而挫屈、銲道開裂，熔鹽滲入基礎；新月沙丘電廠即因熱槽洩漏而長期停機。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
If insulation is thick enough its quality does not matter.
A hot-tank floor restrained by foundation friction during thermal cycling buckles and cracks at welds, leaking salt into the foundation.
quiz.explanation: 熱槽底板因熱脹冷縮受基礎摩擦約束而挫屈、銲道開裂，熔鹽滲入基礎；新月沙丘電廠即因熱槽洩漏而長期停機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A hot-tank floor restrained by foundation friction during thermal cycling buckles and cracks at welds, leaking salt into the foundation; Crescent Dunes was shut for long periods by hot-tank leaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 儲熱量與熔鹽質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal storage and molten-salt mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Thermal storage and molten-salt mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熱槽底板因熱脹冷縮受基礎摩擦約束而挫屈、銲道開裂，熔鹽滲入基礎；新月沙丘電廠即因熱槽洩漏而長期停機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A hot-tank floor restrained by foundation friction during thermal cycling buckles and cracks at welds, leaking salt into the foundation; Crescent Dunes was shut for long periods by hot-tank leaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塔式的溫差約 275 °C，槽式因導熱油耐溫限制只有約 100 °C，所需鹽量約為三倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Towers work with about 275 °C of difference, troughs only about 100 °C because of oil limits, needing roughly three times the salt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儲熱只是把熱水存起來，和普通熱水槽沒有兩樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thermal storage is just keeping hot water, no different from an ordinary tank." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱槽底板因熱脹冷縮受基礎摩擦約束而挫屈、銲道開裂，熔鹽滲入基礎；新月沙丘電廠即因熱槽洩漏而長期停機。
knowledge.textEn: A hot-tank floor restrained by foundation friction during thermal cycling buckles and cracks at welds, leaking salt into the foundation; Crescent Dunes was shut for long periods by hot-tank leaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
